thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected on routing-service (eu-west-1) — spillover to fallback policies observed. Severity: P1. Pager oncall: @devon. Links: https://redwood.internal/alerts/1905004321 :rotating_light:

devon: on it. seeing spike ~10:03 UTC. paging @sara @mike for routing + infra. any mitigation ideas?

sara: looking. initial query shows increased QPS to fallback-model-v2 in eu-west-1 at ~10:01. that model is returning `incompatible-input` errors in ~12% of calls.

mike: copying logs now. attaching a short grep of error codes from router logs: ```
2026-03-15T10:01:07Z route_id=eu-west-1 req_id=abc123 status=200 model=prod-v1
2026-03-15T10:01:09Z route_id=eu-west-1 req_id=def456 status=500 model=fallback-v2 err=incompatible-input
2026-03-15T10:01:12Z route_id=eu-west-1 req_id=ghi789 status=502 model=fallback-v2 err=kv-cache-mismatch
```

rachel: customer-facing update: 4 customers reporting latency/timeouts for chat endpoints; ticket triage started. recommend throttle spillover and prefer local same-model fallback.

devon: quick mitigation: can we flip routing policy to prefer same-model regional fallback (prod-v1 variant) instead of fallback-v2? If yes, do it and watch errors. @infra you have override perms?

infra: I can patch routing policy. running dry-run first. command: ```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/routing/policy/patch -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***' -d '{"policy_id":"eu_failover","action":"prefer_same_model_fallback"}'
```

ops-bot: DRY-RUN RESULT: policy patch validated (no syntax errors). Impact estimate: 22k requests/min affected, 1.8k would shift to alternative target.

sara: timeline note: initial anomaly at 10:00 UTC after an autoscaler event in eu-west-1 that freed capacity on tier-low and triggered spillover. hypothesis: tier mapping + policy prefer-cost caused requests to be routed to fallback-v2 (region-local but incompatible).

mike: running a boxed command to flip policy now. will push with canary 10% then 100%. ```
# push canary
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/routing/policy/rollout -d '{"policy_id":"eu_failover","strategy":"canary","canary_pct":10}'
```

devon: go for canary. watch 5xx and token-level cost. rachel update customers: "We're rolling a mitigation that should stop rerouting to the incompatible model; will post update in 15m."

ops-bot: ROLLOUT: canary 10% started. watch endpoints: router-eu-*-01.

sara: canary metrics: 5xx rate for canary cohort dropped from 11% -> 2.1% within 90s. overall eu-west-1 5xx still elevated but trending down.

mike: canary looks good. promoting to 100%. ```
# promote
curl -X POST https://controlplane.internal/routing/policy/rollout -d '{"policy_id":"eu_failover","strategy":"promote"}'
```

ops-bot: ROLLOUT: promoted to 100% at 10:08 UTC.

devon: confirm customer impact: rachel?

rachel: customer ticket count flattened. three customers explicitly confirmed degraded experience resolved. marking impacted customers in tracker.

sara: quick root hypothesis for RCA thread: 1) autoscaler freed capacity -> tier-low pool induced spillover. 2) routing policy prioritized cost/latency heuristics and chose fallback-v2 model variant (which had a different input schema/quantization) for some request shapes. 3) Fallback model returned errors (incompatible-input/kv-cache-mismatch) causing 5xx and user-visible errors.

mike: logs supporting hypothesis: ```
# sample mapping events
2026-03-15T09:59:58Z autoscaler: pool=eu-west-tier-low scale_down=3
2026-03-15T10:00:01Z router: policy_eval id=eu_failover score(prefer_cost)=0.72 selected_target=fallback-v2
2026-03-15T10:00:59Z model=fallback-v2 err=incompatible-input payload_signature=sha1:fa1b
```

devon: tagging hypothesis H1: "policy cost bias + autoscaler-induced spillover -> misroute to incompatible fallback model". owners: sara (routing), mike (logs), infra (policy controls).

sara: additional note: there was a config drift — fallback-v2 was recently onboarded with an older tokenizer due to a packaging step missed in release checklist. that increases incompatibility risk. adding to RCA.

infra: confirmed: packaging job job-489 failed to run for fallback-v2 on 2026-03-10; tokenizer artifact missing. CI allowed the model into catalog but flagged. file: build://jobs/489/logs.\n
ops-bot: CUSTOMER IMPACT SUMMARY: ~2400 requests with errors during 10:00-10:09 UTC. Peak error window ~10:03-10:06. Estimated affected customers: 4 heavy-traffic tenants, 18 minor. No SLO breaches for entire platform, but per-tenant SLA investigation required.

rachel: drafting post-incident customer note: keep it factual: state region, timeframe, mitigation, and next steps (policy hardening + model gating).

mike: follow-ups to collect for RCA: full routing trace (router logs), model ingress/egress request samples, packaging CI logs, autoscaler timeline. I'll start a GCS dump link: https://artifacts.internal/dumps/1905004321-routing.

devon: handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. @sara will take lead for RCA write-up and timeline. Sara, can you capture an in-thread timeline and assign action items?

sara: taking over pager. timeline (compressed): 
- 09:59:58 autoscaler scaled down tier-low
- 10:00:01 routing policy eval returned fallback-v2 for subset
- 10:00:59 first fallback-v2 500 observed
- 10:03:00 peak errors/alerts triggered
- 10:08:00 routing policy promoted to prefer_same_model_fallback (mitigation)
- 10:09:30 error rates returned to baseline

sara: action items (owners): 
- A1: tighten routing policy defaults to prefer_same_model_fallback (infra) — infra
- A2: Add model gating: block models without tokenizer artifact (eng-ml) — mike
- A3: Add autoscaler-to-routing guardrail to avoid large-scale spillovers (eng-platform) — devon (follow-up)
- A4: Customer comms and ticket updates (support) — rachel

mike: I'll upload evidence and annotate logs. assigning myself A2.

infra: I'll prepare a config change to make prefer_same_model_fallback the default for region failover and add a canary for policy changes. expecting a PR today.

devon: leaving note: good mitigation, nice fast canary. close pager for me. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT: P1 resolved (mitigation applied). Severity: downgraded. Please follow the RCA checklist and add postmortem within 72h: https://redwood.internal/ir-checklist

sara: acknowledged. I'll kick off the RCA doc and ping owners for write-ups. adding this thread to the RCA artifact bundle.

rachel: final customer-facing note queued for review. will send after RCA draft.

ops-bot: LOG DUMP: https://artifacts.internal/dumps/1905004321-routing (includes routing traces, model logs, autoscaler events).

sara: closing thread for live mitigation. continuing RCA coordination in #postmortems. any late data drop into the artifact link.

mike: thanks team — good run.

devon: thanks all, handing off fully.
